items.reason: Emits one rule per breakpoint: the nil-media entry (or count(1) when absent) is the base grid-template-columns; every media entry wraps the grid in HTML.Styled(StringProperty grid-template-columns, atRule: HTML.AtRule.Media(media)), keeping the current selector/pseudo context. The renderer writes base rules before @media groups. Tests in new HTML.Layout.Grid.Lazy Tests.swift.

api_changes: Behaviour/type only: HTML.Layout.Grid.Lazy.body's opaque type is now backed by HTML.AnyView (still `some HTML.View`). Behaviour change: a Breakpoints dictionary whose first entry had a media key used to apply that entry unconditionally; it now applies only inside its media query, with one column as the base when there is no nil-keyed entry.
